name: secret-box
description: Resolves {{secret:NAME}} placeholders from Linux Secret Service or macOS Keychain at execution time, with optional directory scopes and host-specific output scrubbing.

secretScopes.title: Secret scopes
secretScopes.description: Optional JSON object mapping secret names to arrays of absolute directory globs. * and ? match within a segment; ** matches directories. Unlisted secrets are unrestricted; an empty array denies a secret everywhere.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, dry (report only, nothing is rewritten or scrubbed) or on.
